   303→
   304→/// Parse a duration string like "500ms", "2s", "1m" into a `Duration`
   305→fn parse_duration(s: &str) -> Result<std::time::Duration, String> {
   306→    let s = s.trim();
   307→    if s.is_empty() {
   308→        return Err("duration cannot be empty".to_string());
   309→    }
   310→
   311→    // Find where the numeric part ends
   312→    let num_end = s
   313→        .find(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit() && c != '.')
   314→        .unwrap_or(s.len());
   315→
   316→    let (num_str, unit) = s.split_at(num_end);
   317→    let num: f64 = num_str
   318→        .parse()
   319→        .map_err(|_| format!("invalid number: {num_str}"))?;
   320→
   321→    let multiplier = match unit.trim().to_lowercase().as_str() {
   322→        "ms" | "millis" | "milliseconds" => 1.0,
   323→        "s" | "sec" | "secs" | "second" | "seconds" | "" => 1000.0,
   324→        "m" | "min" | "mins" | "minute" | "minutes" => 60_000.0,
   325→        _ => return Err(format!("unknown time unit: {unit}")),
   326→    };
   327→
   328→    #[expect(clippy::cast_sign_loss, clippy::cast_possible_truncation)]
   329→    let millis = (num * multiplier) as u64;
   330→    Ok(std::time::Duration::from_millis(millis))
   331→}

    28→/// Query a flight client and return the result as a vector of record batches
    29→///
    30→/// # Errors
    31→///
    32→/// - If the flight client fails to query
    33→pub async fn query_to_batches(
    34→    flight_client: Arc<FlightClient>,
    35→    sql: &str,
    36→) -> Result<Vec<RecordBatch>> {
    37→    let mut stream = flight_client.query(sql).await?;
    38→
    39→    let mut batches = Vec::new();
    40→    while let Some(batch) = stream.next().await {
    41→        match batch {
    42→            Ok(batch) => batches.push(batch),
    43→            Err(e) => return Err(anyhow!(e.to_string())),
    44→        }
    45→    }
    46→    Ok(batches)
    47→}
    48→
    49→pub async fn put_batches(
    50→    client: &mut FlightClient,
    51→    dataset_path: &str,
    52→    batches: Vec<RecordBatch>,
    53→) -> Result<()> {
    54→    Ok(client.publish(dataset_path, batches).await?)
    55→}
    56→
    57→pub struct PreparedStatementParamColumn {
    58→    name: String,
    59→    dtype: arrow::datatypes::DataType,
    60→    nullable: bool,
    61→    array: ArrayRef,
    62→}
    63→
    64→impl PreparedStatementParamColumn {
    65→    pub fn new(
    66→        name: String,
    67→        dtype: arrow::datatypes::DataType,
    68→        nullable: bool,
    69→        array: ArrayRef,
    70→    ) -> Self {
    71→        Self {
    72→            name,
    73→            dtype,
    74→            nullable,
    75→            array,
    76→        }
    77→    }
    78→}
    79→
    80→/// # Usage
    81→///
    82→/// ```rust,ignore
    83→/// create_param_batch(vec![
    84→///   PreparedStatementParamColumn::new(
    85→///     "$1",
    86→///     arrow::datatypes::DataType::Int64,
    87→///     false,
    88→///     Arc::new(Int64Array::from(vec![41])) as Arc<dyn arrow::array::Array>
    89→///   ),
    90→///   PreparedStatementParamColumn::new(
    91→///     "$2",
    92→///     arrow::datatypes::DataType::Utf8,
    93→///     true,
    94→///     Arc::new(StringArray::from(vec![Some("a"), Some("b")])) as Arc<dyn arrow::array::Array>
    95→///   )
    96→/// ])?;
    97→/// ```
    98→pub fn create_param_batch(
    99→    params: Vec<PreparedStatementParamColumn>,
   100→) -> Result<RecordBatch, anyhow::Error> {
   101→    let (fields, columns): (Vec<FieldRef>, Vec<ArrayRef>) = params
   102→        .into_iter()
   103→        .map(|col| {
   104→            let PreparedStatementParamColumn {
   105→                name,
   106→                dtype,
   107→                nullable,
   108→                array,
   109→            } = col;
   110→            (Arc::new(Field::new(name, dtype, nullable)), array)
   111→        })
   112→        .unzip();
   113→
   114→    RecordBatch::try_new(Arc::new(Schema::new(fields)), columns).map_err(Into::into)
   115→}
   116→

    17→use std::process::Command;
    18→
    19→// This should also append "-dirty" if there are uncommitted changes
    20→#[must_use]
    21→pub fn get_commit_sha() -> String {
    22→    let short_sha = Command::new("git")
    23→        .args(["rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"])
    24→        .output()
    25→        .map_or_else(
    26→            |_| "unknown".to_string(),
    27→            |output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string(),
    28→        );
    29→    format!(
    30→        "{}{}",
    31→        short_sha,
    32→        if is_repo_dirty() { "-dirty" } else { "" }
    33→    )
    34→}
    35→
    36→#[must_use]
    37→pub fn get_branch_name() -> String {
    38→    Command::new("git")
    39→        .args(["rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"])
    40→        .output()
    41→        .map_or_else(
    42→            |_| "unknown".to_string(),
    43→            |output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string(),
    44→        )
    45→}
    46→
    47→#[expect(clippy::map_unwrap_or)]
    48→fn is_repo_dirty() -> bool {
    49→    let output = Command::new("git")
    50→        .arg("status")
    51→        .arg("--porcelain")
    52→        .output()
    53→        .map(|output| {
    54→            std::str::from_utf8(&output.stdout)
    55→                .map(ToString::to_string)
    56→                .unwrap_or_else(|_| String::new())
    57→        })
    58→        .unwrap_or_else(|_| String::new());
    59→
    60→    !output.trim().is_empty()
    61→}
